help.acpIdleTimeout: Sessions idle beyond this duration exit automatically and restore on reopen
help.browserRefresh: Minimum interval between frame pushes; larger saves resources, smaller feels smoother, changes apply immediately
help.launchAtLogin: Start automatically in the background after login and stay in the system tray

help.pollInterval: Instant updates come from the file watcher; this only drives stale-session cleanup and acts as a backstop when the watcher misses events.
help.terminalPostOpenCommand: Executed automatically after cd-ing into the repo. Leave empty to only cd. e.g. add_proxy or ./bootstrap.sh; join multiple commands with &&, e.g. add_proxy && npm run dev.
help.scrollbackRows: How many lines of history output you can scroll back through in the terminal. Applies immediately after saving. Larger values allow more history at higher memory cost

placeholder.pat: Enter a new token to replace; leave empty to keep

help.pat: Used by the github MCP tools inside AI terminals to call the GitHub API (create PR, query CI status). Create one at github.com/settings/tokens (repo and workflow scopes recommended). The token is stored only in the local app database.
